strings.name: Zhang Ruimin
strings.role: Haier founder and honorary chairman of the group’s board
strings.summary: Zhang Ruimin is a Chinese business leader who became director of Qingdao Refrigerator General Factory in 1984. He led Haier’s quality improvement, international expansion and organizational change, developing Rendanheyi to connect employee entrepreneurship with customer value. After handing over leadership in 2021, he became honorary chairman and continued contributing to management debates.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Factory director, chairman, CEO and honorary chairman are distinct, as are Haier Group and listed companies. Management models, awards and case studies do not independently establish universal effectiveness.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped transform Haier from an appliance factory into an international enterprise and explored organizational management and employee entrepreneurship.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Haier’s biography records a 1995 MBA from the University of Science and Technology of China; its alumni association confirms his master’s alumni status.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current role and succession
strings.facts.f2.value: Became honorary chairman after resigning as board chairman on November 5, 2021; Zhou Yunjie succeeded as group chairman and CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Quality management and international expansion
strings.highlights.h1.text: From refrigerator quality improvement, helped expand Haier across products and countries; company achievements include the work of management teams and employees.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Rendanheyi and organizational experimentation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Links employee value with customer value, exploring autonomous units and micro-enterprises; business-school cases discuss their design and challenges.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Explains R theory with Stuart Crainer
strings.timeline.t1.text: At the Qingdao forum, presents their jointly proposed management ideas based on Rendanheyi; the proposal is not a universally validated law.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Receives Thinkers50 Lifetime Achievement Award
strings.timeline.t2.text: The awarding organization confirms the 2023 honor, distinct from its 2015 Ideas into Practice Award.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Hands over leadership
strings.timeline.t3.text: Does not seek nomination to the new board and is invited to be honorary chairman; Zhou Yunjie becomes chairman and CEO.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Qingdao Haier completes GE Appliances acquisition
strings.timeline.t4.text: The transaction concerns GE Appliances, not all of General Electric; the buyer is Qingdao Haier, not Zhang personally.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Proposes Rendanheyi
strings.timeline.t5.text: A retrospective republished by Haier dates the employee/customer-value management model to the global managers’ meeting.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Haier management becomes an HBS case
strings.timeline.t6.text: Haier Group (A) examines the Red Star acquisition decision and management culture; publication conveys neither a Harvard degree nor a faculty appointment.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Destroys defective refrigerators to emphasize quality
strings.timeline.t7.text: Haier’s retrospective records his decision to destroy 76 faulty refrigerators, a landmark in the company’s quality-management history.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Becomes factory director
strings.timeline.t8.text: Takes charge of Haier’s predecessor, Qingdao Refrigerator General Factory; his entire subsequent career cannot be labeled a chairman-and-CEO tenure.
